decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The change of use hereby permitted shall not begin until details of secure, covered and lockable parking for at least eight cycles have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the approved facilities have been installed.The details shall show the location, dimensions, stands, enclosure and access arrangements, and shall be designed in accordance with the London Cycling Design Standards. Notwithstanding the indicative cycle-storage annotations on drawing 1821/9, the facilities and their access shall be accommodated within existing structures or existing hard-surfaced areas. Their installation shall not require vegetation clearance, loss of vegetated ground, removal of trees or hedges, or excavation damaging the roots of retained trees or hedges. The layout shall avoid obstruction of vehicle access, pedestrian circulation and the escape routes and final exits shown on the approved floor plans.The approved facilities shall thereafter be retained, kept available for residents' cycle parking and kept free from obstruction for the duration of the permitted HMO use.Reason: To secure convenient and safe cycle parking before the increased occupancy begins, promote sustainable travel and protect existing habitat, in accordance with London Plan Policies T5 and G6 and Core Strategy Policies CS6, DM8 and DM6.

The change of use hereby permitted shall not begin until details of refuse and recycling storage sufficient to serve eight residents have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the approved facilities have been installed.The details shall specify the number and capacity of containers, enclosure design, storage position on the existing hard-surfaced forecourt and access for residents and collection. Installation shall not require vegetation clearance, loss of vegetated ground, removal of trees or hedges, or excavation damaging the roots of retained trees or hedges. The facilities shall not obstruct vehicle access, pedestrian circulation, escape routes or final exits.The approved storage facilities shall thereafter be retained and kept available for their intended purpose for the duration of the permitted HMO use. Containers shall be kept within the approved storage area except when presented for collection in accordance with the waste collection service's arrangements, and shall be returned to that area following collection.Reason: To ensure adequate waste storage is available before the increased occupancy begins and to protect residential amenity, the appearance of the area and existing habitat, in accordance with London Plan Policies SI 7 and G6 and Core Strategy Policies CS9, DM10 and DM6.

The HMO hereby permitted shall accommodate no more than eight residents in total. The eight bedrooms shown on drawings 1821/1, 1821/4 and 1821/5 shall each be occupied by no more than one resident.The communal kitchen/living room shown on drawing 1821/1 and the landing-accessed shower rooms on drawings 1821/4 and 1821/5 shall be retained and made available to the residents for their respective communal purposes throughout the permitted HMO use. Notwithstanding the room-number labels on those drawings, both landing-accessed shower rooms shall remain communal and shall not be allocated exclusively to an individual bedroom. The communal kitchen/living room and the communal shower rooms shall not be used as bedrooms.Reason: To restrict the intensity of occupation to that assessed and retain sufficient shared facilities, in the interests of existing and future residents, in accordance with London Plan Policies D3 and D6 and Core Strategy Policy DM10.

The change of use hereby permitted shall not begin until the protected stairway and circulation routes, fire-resisting doors and final exits shown on drawings 1821/1, 1821/4 and 1821/5 have been provided. Those arrangements shall thereafter be retained, and the escape routes and final exits kept unobstructed and available for their intended purpose, for the duration of the permitted HMO use.Reason: To secure the escape layout before increased occupancy begins and retain the arrangements on which the planning assessment relies, in accordance with London Plan Policy D12.
